dedupe_keys.name: compound flood potential from river discharge and storm surge extremes at the global scale

description: Anaïs Couasnon publishes global compound-flood potential outputs used in a peer-reviewed study of coincident river discharge and storm-surge extremes. Zenodo provides CSV and NetCDF files under CC BY 4.0 with free access. The source time series span 1980–2014 at river mouths worldwide; the deposit contains derived analysis results and figure data, not a live gauge feed. These values can screen where paired coastal and river forcing should enter infrastructure flood simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this derived global analysis. Temporal and coastal spatial resolution are not specified on the landing page and must be checked from the file before quantitative coupling. The analysis estimates joint potential under selected extreme-event definitions; it does not supply flood depths at individual assets. Neither file was downloaded, and no dependence statistic or figure was reproduced.
